payload.leagueSummary: This rolling window is still a NET knife fight at the top, with KeithK75, Dan94, and the rest of the front pack trading blows while a couple of guys are just trying not to donate sleeves to the lake. The underlying golf says the separation is coming from tee-to-green quality: KeithK75 and Dan94 are separating themselves with real ball-striking, while the middle and lower tiers are leaking shots in all the usual dumb places. BigTime, DREADFUL, and MashedBROtato are the cautionary tales here — too many missed greens, too many extra putts, and way too much self-inflicted bullshit.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 is the cleanest profile in the room: elite approach, elite tee-to-green, and enough putting to keep the whole thing from turning into a pure ball-striking flex parade.
Dan94 is the loudest driver in the league and it’s not close, but the scary part is that the rest of the bag is also doing work instead of just standing around watching the tee ball strut.
BigTime, DREADFUL, and MashedBROtato are all fighting different flavors of the same problem: the short game and putting are murdering whatever their tee shots pretend to build.
